fromContent: We always see the same face of the Moon from Earth.
toContent: The Moon is tidally locked: it rotates exactly once per orbit, so the same hemisphere always points toward Earth.

fromContent: A straight pencil standing in a glass of water looks bent at the water's surface.
toContent: Light refracts, changing direction, when it crosses between media of different optical density such as water and air.

fromContent: Plants grown in complete darkness become tall, spindly, and pale.
toContent: Without light a plant cannot photosynthesize or make chlorophyll, and it elongates abnormally while searching for a light source.

fromContent: Spreading salt on icy roads makes the ice melt.
toContent: Dissolved salt lowers the freezing point of water, so ice can melt at temperatures below 0 degrees Celsius.

fromContent: Merge sort runs in O(n log n) time even in the worst case.
toContent: Merge sort recursively splits the list in half, giving about log n levels, and merges each level with linear n work.

fromContent: Hyperinflation rapidly wipes out the value of people's cash savings.
toContent: Under hyperinflation the price level rises so fast that a unit of currency loses most of its purchasing power within days.

fromContent: Astronauts aboard the International Space Station float in apparent weightlessness.
toContent: The station and everything in it are in continuous free fall around the Earth, so no normal force is felt as weight.

fromContent: Identical twins carry essentially the same DNA.
toContent: Identical twins arise when a single fertilized egg splits into two embryos, each inheriting the same genome.

fromContent: When both endpoint documents of a Daftari edge are edited, the loop re-examines that edge.
toContent: Editing a document changes its content hash, which the session-start event clock detects and uses to mark dependent edges due.

fromContent: Dividing a number by zero is undefined.
toContent: Division is defined as the inverse of multiplication, but nothing multiplied by zero gives a nonzero product, so the inverse has no value.

fromContent: At the same room temperature, a metal handle feels colder to the touch than a wooden one.
toContent: Metal conducts heat away from your skin far faster than wood, drawing warmth from your hand more quickly even at equal temperature.

fromContent: A helium-filled balloon rises upward when released in air.
toContent: Helium is much less dense than the surrounding air, so the buoyant force exceeds the balloon's weight.

fromContent: HTTPS stops an eavesdropper on the network from reading the password you submit to a website.
toContent: HTTPS encrypts the data in transit using TLS, so anyone intercepting the traffic sees only ciphertext.

fromContent: Eating raw or undercooked kidney beans can cause acute nausea and vomiting.
toContent: Raw kidney beans contain the toxic lectin phytohaemagglutinin, which is destroyed only by thorough boiling.

fromContent: A solar eclipse can happen only at the time of a new moon.
toContent: A solar eclipse requires the Moon to pass directly between the Earth and the Sun, which is exactly the alignment that defines a new moon.

fromContent: Central banks raise interest rates to bring down high inflation.
toContent: Higher interest rates make borrowing costlier and saving more attractive, which reduces aggregate spending and cools price growth.

fromContent: You can hear someone speaking around a corner even though you cannot see them around it.
toContent: Sound's wavelength is comparable to everyday objects so it diffracts strongly around them, whereas light's far shorter wavelength diffracts negligibly.

fromContent: Daftari can fully rebuild its search index after the .daftari/index.db file is deleted.
toContent: The markdown files retain all content and frontmatter, which is everything the indexer reads to construct the index.

fromContent: Stomach acid does not normally digest the stomach itself.
toContent: The stomach lining secretes a protective mucus and bicarbonate layer that neutralizes the acid right at the stomach wall.

fromContent: The square root of 2 cannot be expressed as a ratio of two integers.
toContent: Assuming sqrt(2) = a/b in lowest terms forces both a and b to be even, contradicting that the fraction was in lowest terms.
